title: North Korea Banned This Korean Snack — The Wild Story of Choco Pie
description:
In 2014, North Korea reportedly banned a snack. Not a weapon, not a phone. A small round chocolate cake from South Korea. This is the wild life story of Choco Pie: born from a trip to Georgia, USA, turned into a soldier's currency in Korea's army, a tea-time hero in Russia, an offering on Vietnamese family altars, and a black-market treasure north of the border.

Chapters
0:00 Intro
1:05 A Korean snack born in Georgia
2:20 Currency in the barracks
3:06 Russia falls in love
4:20 On the family altar in Vietnam
5:26 The black market up north
